content.short: B2B cross-border payments, FX and treasury platform for emerging markets.
content.description: Verto is a global B2B cross-border payments and foreign-exchange platform, founded in 2019, that helps businesses send, receive, and exchange money across borders with a focus on emerging markets, particularly Africa. Through its accounts and APIs, companies can hold multiple currencies, access competitive FX, and make and collect payments in over 190 countries, tackling the friction and high costs that businesses face when trading with hard-to-reach markets. Verto serves startups, SMEs, and large corporates that need reliable settlement into currencies traditional banks handle slowly or expensively, and it has signaled plans to add stablecoin-based payment rails to make international transfers faster and more efficient. By combining multi-currency accounts, FX, and treasury tools, Verto positions itself as a cross-border money-movement engine for global business.
